about: A PHP library for reading and writing spreadsheet files like Excel.

prs.title: XLOOKUP returns a real #N/A when nothing matches
prs.broken: When XLOOKUP found nothing, it returned the text "#N/A!" instead of the error. ISNA and IFNA did not see it as an error.
prs.changed: It now returns the real #N/A error, as Excel does.
prs.matters: Formulas that catch a missing lookup with IFNA or ISNA work the same as in Excel.
